title: Failure mode wiring (OOM auto-fallback, kernel hard-fail)
description:
## Goal

Wire the executor-level failure-mode policy per Phase 0 §8: catch
`RecoverableError::OutOfMemory` from GPU stages and substitute the
`cpu_fallback()` stage for the offending batch; treat
`FatalError::KernelLaunch` (and other Fatal variants) as hard-fail
with full diagnostic dump.

## Context

Task under story `9e853c62` (Hybrid CPU+GPU executor) within epic
`gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §8 (seam decision: GPU
stages SIGNAL only; the executor DISPATCHES the fallback). Wave C.2
fan-out from `75c22fa8`.

This task is the **executor-side** of the OOM/hard-fail policy.
Phase B `ed575f15` already audited the GPU stages to ensure they
signal correctly, return real `cpu_fallback()` accessors, and built
the reusable fault injectors (`OomInjector`/`KernelErrorInjector` in
`tests/common/mod.rs`). This task makes the executor act on those
signals and **consumes those injectors** to drive the substitution
test.

**AMENDMENT 2026-06-09 (user-approved scope corrections — NO rigor
change; one §11 alignment).**
- This task is the OWNER of the moved-here obligations from `ed575f15`:
  it CONSUMES the shared injectors (deliverable-3 below) and HONORS
  `PipelineConfig::strict_gpu` (deliverable-2 below).
- `mean_iters` §11 ALIGNMENT: the OOM-fallback run is a **mixed
  CPU+GPU** run (the OOM'd batch runs on CPU, the rest on GPU), so it
  falls under the design §11 CPU-vs-GPU contract, which is byte-identical
  on `fer/frames/errors` and EXCLUDES `mean_iters` (RDNA2 transcendental
  ULP drift changes the BP iteration count ±1 across a device boundary —
  4-column `mean_iters` byte-identity vs a CPU-only reference is
  physically unsatisfiable, not a rigor target). The decode-correctness
  rigor (`fer/frames/errors` byte-identical) is fully retained; this is
  the SAME contract every other CPU-vs-GPU comparison in the epic uses.
- The `--strict-gpu` **CLI flag** surface is delivered by D.2
  `bbf6b6ee` (the gf2-sim campaign binary); this task delivers the
  executor's **honoring** of `PipelineConfig::strict_gpu`.

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-sim/src/executor/failure.rs`:
   - `Scheduler::dispatch_with_fallback(stage, input, scratch)`
     wrapping every GPU-stage call:
     - On `Ok(o)`: return.
     - On `Err(StageError::Recoverable(RecoverableError::OutOfMemory{...}))`:
       call `stage.cpu_fallback().expect("ed575f15 guarantees present")`
       on the same input; if that also fails, return
       `FatalError::CpuFallbackAlsoFailed{ original }`.
     - On `Err(StageError::Fatal(_))`: serialize the diagnostic dump
       (HIP error code, last kernel launch args, device id, SNR + batch
       context) and propagate.
   - The diagnostic dump format is JSON in
     `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/diagnostic-dumps/<timestamp>.json` (one
     file per hard-fail event).
2. Executor honoring of `PipelineConfig::strict_gpu` (the field exists
   from `ed575f15`):
   - When set, OOM is **promoted** to `FatalError::OutOfMemory` (no
     fallback) and the executor hard-fails. (The `--strict-gpu` CLI
     surface that sets this field is D.2 `bbf6b6ee`'s; this task wires
     the executor's response to the field.)
3. Fault-injection tests in `tests/executor_failure_modes.rs`,
   CONSUMING `ed575f15`'s injectors via `mod common;`:
   - Inject OOM via `common::OomInjector`; assert the pipeline completes
     with a `tracing::warn!{batch_id, snr_idx, device_id}` event and
     byte-identical **`fer / frames / errors`** vs a CPU-only reference
     (the fallback ran on CPU for the affected batch). `mean_iters` is
     LOGGED, not asserted (§11 CPU-vs-GPU exclusion — the run is mixed
     CPU+GPU).
   - Inject kernel error via `common::KernelErrorInjector`; assert
     non-zero exit, a JSON diagnostic dump under the configured
     directory, and a `tracing::error!` event.
   - With `strict_gpu` set, the OOM injection now hard-fails; assertion:
     deterministic non-zero exit on the same seed.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] OOM auto-fallback works: a forced OOM during a hybrid run
  yields the same **`fer / frames / errors`** (the design §11
  CPU-vs-GPU three-column contract; `mean_iters` logged not asserted,
  since the OOM-fallback run is mixed CPU+GPU) as a CPU-only reference
  run at the same seed.
- [hard] The executor CONSUMES `ed575f15`'s shared injectors
  (`OomInjector`/`KernelErrorInjector` via `mod common;`) to drive this
  substitution test (the consumption obligation moved here from
  `ed575f15`).
- [hard] Hard-fail path: a forced kernel error yields a non-zero exit,
  a JSON diagnostic dump in the configured directory, and a
  `tracing::error!` event with all the relevant context.
- [hard] The executor honors `PipelineConfig::strict_gpu`: when set, it
  promotes OOM to `FatalError::OutOfMemory` (hard-fail), verified by the
  test suite (config-driven). (The `--strict-gpu` CLI flag itself is a
  `[hard]` criterion on D.2 `bbf6b6ee`.)
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review` gates green.

## Non-goals

- GPU stage error signalling (owned by Phase B `ed575f15`).
- The `--strict-gpu` CLI flag surface (owned by D.2 `bbf6b6ee`).
- Diagnostic-dump tooling beyond JSON serialisation (defer).
